title: Vitamin D and Immunity, Lots of Evidence
summary: Dr. John Campbell reviews studies on vitamin D deficiency and immunity, including links to influenza and COVID-19, with Public Health England advice. He walks through the sources he cites.
why: Cited in COVID-era threads as a physician's evidence-based argument that vitamin D is cheap, low-risk and worth considering.

quote.text: It's cheap and has minimal downside.
